name: Meeting Brief Bot
summary: Before each meeting, the app pulls attendee email threads, summarizes any agenda PDF, creates three talking points, and sends a Slack brief.

items.title: List upcoming meetings
items.description: Read the user's calendar to find meetings happening today.
items.proved_when: System logs show a calendar read request for events in the next 24 hours.
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

items.title: Get meeting attendees
items.description: Extract the list of attendees from each calendar event.
items.proved_when: For each upcoming meeting, attendee email addresses are extracted and stored.
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

items.title: Last email thread per attendee
items.description: Fetch the most recent email thread between the user and each meeting attendee.
items.proved_when: For each attendee, the latest Gmail thread ID is retrieved and logged.

items.title: Summarize attached agenda PDF
items.description: If a meeting event includes a PDF attachment, extract its text and produce a brief summary.
items.proved_when: For each meeting with a PDF attachment, a summary text under 200 characters is generated and saved.
items.source_quote: summary of any attached agenda PDF

items.title: Generate three talking points
items.description: Create three concise talking points based on the attendee email thread and agenda summary.
items.proved_when: For each meeting, exactly three talking points are generated and stored.

items.title: Compose Slack brief message
items.description: Combine attendee email threads, agenda summary, and talking points into a formatted message for Slack.
items.proved_when: A formatted Slack message payload is created for each upcoming meeting.

items.title: Send brief via Slack
items.description: Deliver the composed brief to the user as a direct message in Slack.
items.proved_when: Slack API returns a success response for each brief message sent.

items.title: Schedule brief delivery
items.description: Trigger the brief generation and delivery a set time before each meeting starts.
items.proved_when: A scheduled job triggers at the configured lead time before each calendar event.
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

questions.text: Which Slack workspace should this post to?

not_in_this_version.title: Non‑PDF attachment handling
not_in_this_version.reason: Request only mentions agenda PDF; other file types are out of scope.

not_in_this_version.title: Slack channel posting
not_in_this_version.reason: Default delivers brief as a direct message; posting to a channel was not requested.
